_comment: Ros2Sim arguments for ROS 2 Jazzy + gz sim (Harmonic) + TurtleBot3 burger via ros_gz_bridge. Untested by the author: run `python run_webots_c1.py --sim ros2 --mode probe --ros2-config configs/ros2_jazzy_tb3.json` first. On Jazzy, /cmd_vel is usually geometry_msgs/TwistStamped; set twist_stamped to false if your bridge expects Twist.
